concept.title: Hybrid battery SOC (State of Charge) gauge

conbody.p: The hybrid battery State of Charge (SOC) gauge indicates the remaining level of hybrid battery power. If the gauge is near the Low (L) level, the vehicle automatically operates the engine to charge the battery.

If the Service Indicator () and Malfunction Indicator Lamp (MIL) () illuminate when the SOC gauge is near the Low (L) level, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
